Hamburger Buns
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 24, 2009 - 11:58pm

Ingredients




1 pkg. active dry yeast
1 1/4 cups warm water
2 tablespoons sugar
4 cups Bisquick
2 tablespoons dry onion flakes or ⅓ c. grated cheese, or

Preparation

1 In mixer bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Add sugar and 1/2 of the Bisquick. Beat 2 minutes on medium speed. Add remaining Bisquick and choice of onion flakes, grated cheese, or caraway seeds. Blend with spoon until smooth. Cover with cloth and let rise in warm place until double, about 30 minutes. Stir down by beating 25 strokes. Drop dough by spoonfuls on greased baking sheet, making 12 mounds 2 inches apart. Dough will be sticky. Flatten tops with floured fingers in rounds about 1/2 inch thick. Again let rise
